data.one_liner: Official Flutter plugin for SSLCommerz payment gateway integration on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: It provides a native bridge to integrate the SSLCommerz payment gateway into Flutter apps. Developers can initialize payments with custom configurations, customer data, product profiles, EMI, and shipment info.
use_when: You need to integrate the SSLCommerz payment gateway in a Flutter application targeting Android and iOS.
You want support for features like saved cards, EMI, and specialized product profiles (travel, telecom, physical, non-physical).
avoid_when: Your app targets platforms other than Android and iOS.
You need a different payment gateway like Stripe or PayPal instead of SSLCommerz.
strengths: Supports modern Android devices with 16KB page size support.
Comprehensive parameter support including EMI, shipment, and customer details.
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platforms only.
License type is unknown from pubspec metadata.
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS deployment target 13.0 and Android minSdkVersion 21. Must initialize with store credentials and optional IPN, shipment, or customer info.
data.minimal_example:
Sslcommerz sslcommerz = Sslcommerz(initializer: SSLCommerzInitialization(multi_card_name: "visa,master,bkash", currency: SSLCurrencyType.BDT, product_category: "Food", sdkType: SSLCSdkType.TESTBOX, store_id: "your_store_id", store_passwd: "your_store_password", total_amount: "payment_amount", tran_id: "custom_transaction_id"));
sslcommerz.payNow();
